notes: Fixed _parse_markdown_table() defect in audit_feature_touch_coverage.py. Root cause: the original parser terminated on the first non-pipe line after entering table mode, causing it to read only the first (Trigger-Evidence Record) table in the T8.1 matrix file and never reach the canonical 37-row 5-column matrix. Fix replaces the single-table parser with a multi-table scanner (_collect_all_tables) that accumulates all pipe-line blocks, then identifies the canonical matrix by matching all five required column headers (tools, skills, model, effort, prompt body) via _is_canonical_matrix_table. Two new rule constants added: RULE_TABLE_NOT_FOUND (BLOCKER severity) and RULE_TABLE_AMBIGUOUS (MAJOR severity). The smoke test was extended with scenario F (multi-table markdown fixture reproducing the exact T8.1 regression pattern). Live SA-14 audit verdict: PASS (37 rows, 37 expected, 0 findings). All 6 smoke scenarios pass.
